mapper.select: SELECT a.*, g.goods_name AS name, g.goods_id AS goodsId FROM tb_alert a JOIN tb_goods g ON a.goods_no = g.goods_no
SELECT * FROM tb_daily_price dp JOIN tb_goods g ON dp.goods_id = g.goods_id WHERE g.goods_no = #{goodsNo} ORDER BY register_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.*, g.goods_name AS name, g.goods_image AS image, dp.price AS currentPrice FROM tb_alert a JOIN tb_goods g ON a.goods_no = g.goods_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d1.* FROM tb_daily_price d1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT goods_id, MAX(register_date) AS max_date FROM tb_daily_price GROUP BY goods_id ) d2 ON d1.goods_id = d2.goods_id AND d1.register_date = d2.max_date ) dp ON g.goods_id = dp.goods_id WHERE a.users_no = #{userId} AND a.is_achieve = 0 AND DATE_ADD(a.register_date, INTERVAL a.period DAY) >= NOW()

SELECT a.*, g.goods_name AS name, g.goods_image AS image, dp.price AS currentPrice FROM tb_alert a JOIN tb_goods g ON a.goods_no = g.goods_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d1.* FROM tb_daily_price d1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT goods_id, MAX(register_date) AS max_date FROM tb_daily_price GROUP BY goods_id ) d2 ON d1.goods_id = d2.goods_id AND d1.register_date = d2.max_date ) dp ON g.goods_id = dp.goods_id WHERE a.users_no = #{userId} AND a.is_achieve = 1 AND DATE_ADD(a.register_date, INTERVAL a.period DAY) >= NOW()

SELECT a.*, g.goods_name AS name, g.goods_image AS image, dp.price AS currentPrice FROM tb_alert a JOIN tb_goods g ON a.goods_no = g.goods_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d1.* FROM tb_daily_price d1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT goods_id, MAX(register_date) AS max_date FROM tb_daily_price GROUP BY goods_id ) d2 ON d1.goods_id = d2.goods_id AND d1.register_date = d2.max_date ) dp ON g.goods_id = dp.goods_id WHERE a.users_no = #{userId} AND a.is_achieve = 0 AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), a.register_date) > a.period
SELECT a.*, g.goods_name AS name FROM tb_alert a JOIN tb_goods g ON a.goods_no = g.goods_no WHERE a.users_no = #{userId} AND a.is_sent IN (1, 2) -- 1: 달성, 2: 만료 ORDER BY a.register_date DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_alert WHERE users_no = #{userId} AND is_sent IN (1,2) AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_alert SET is_read = 1 WHERE users_no = #{userId} AND is_sent IN (1, 2) AND is_read = 0
